_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in only what you need. Everything NSE-based works with no configuration at all.
_upstox: Optional. Needed only for intraday candles, live quotes and the fundamentals in nse-results. Get one free at upstox.com/developer. Without it those skills say so and the rest still work.
_capital: Your trading capital in rupees. nse-risk sizes positions against this.
_risk: How much of capital you accept losing on one trade. 1 percent is a common starting point. nse-risk blocks anything above this.
_max_positions: How many open positions at once before nse-risk refuses a new one.
